rules.title: No imagery appealing to minors
rules.checkPrompt: Does this image contain cartoons, characters, mascots, or imagery styles that would reasonably appeal to minors (e.g. bright cartoon mascots, toy-like packaging, candy-like branding)? Answer strictly based on what is visibly depicted.
rules.citation: Drafted from publicly available state cannabis-advertising regulations — not yet legal-reviewed.
rules.suggestedFixTemplate: Remove cartoon/minor-appealing elements; use adult-oriented imagery and styling.

rules.title: No persons who appear to be minors depicted
rules.checkPrompt: Does this image depict any person who reasonably appears to be under the age of 21, whether or not they are interacting with the product?
rules.citation: Drafted from publicly available state cannabis-advertising regulations — not yet legal-reviewed.
rules.suggestedFixTemplate: Remove or replace any model/person who appears to be under 21 with a model who clearly appears to be an adult.

rules.title: No apparently underage models shown using or holding product
rules.checkPrompt: Is any person who appears to be under 21 shown holding, using, or in close proximity to a cannabis product or paraphernalia in this image?
rules.citation: Drafted from publicly available state cannabis-advertising regulations — not yet legal-reviewed.
rules.suggestedFixTemplate: Ensure all models depicted with product visibly and unambiguously appear to be adults (25+ recommended for safety margin).

rules.title: Required disclaimer text present and legible
rules.checkPrompt: Is a legible warning/disclaimer statement visible in the image, consistent with typical state cannabis-ad disclaimer requirements (e.g. age restriction such as '21+ only', health warning, or 'keep out of reach of children')?
rules.citation: Drafted from publicly available state cannabis-advertising regulations — not yet legal-reviewed.
rules.suggestedFixTemplate: Add the required disclaimer text (e.g. age-restriction and health-warning language) in a legible, high-contrast placement.

rules.title: Disclaimer text meets legibility/contrast expectations
rules.checkPrompt: If disclaimer or warning text is present, is it rendered at a size and contrast that a typical viewer could read it without difficulty (not obscured, not low-contrast, not cropped)?
rules.citation: Drafted from publicly available state cannabis-advertising regulations — not yet legal-reviewed.
rules.suggestedFixTemplate: Increase disclaimer text size/contrast and ensure it is not cropped, obscured, or placed over a busy background.

rules.title: No unsubstantiated health/medical claims depicted
rules.checkPrompt: Does the image depict or imply medical/health claims (e.g. 'cures', 'treats', 'heals') about cannabis products without qualification or supporting disclosure?
rules.citation: Drafted from publicly available state cannabis-advertising regulations — not yet legal-reviewed.
rules.suggestedFixTemplate: Remove or qualify health-claim imagery/text; consult legal before using any medical or therapeutic claims.

rules.title: No claims implying cannabis is a necessary treatment or cure
rules.checkPrompt: Does the image or any visible text imply that cannabis use is medically necessary, a required treatment, or a substitute for professional medical care?
rules.citation: Drafted from publicly available state cannabis-advertising regulations — not yet legal-reviewed.
rules.suggestedFixTemplate: Remove language/imagery implying medical necessity; add a qualifying disclaimer if any wellness framing is retained.

rules.title: No unsubstantiated safety claims
rules.checkPrompt: Does the image or visible text claim the product is 'safe', 'risk-free', 'non-addictive', or otherwise make an absolute safety claim without qualification?
rules.citation: Drafted from publicly available state cannabis-advertising regulations — not yet legal-reviewed.
rules.suggestedFixTemplate: Remove absolute safety language; use qualified, non-absolute wording or remove the claim entirely.

rules.title: No exaggerated or promotional potency/dosage claims
rules.checkPrompt: Does the image feature potency or dosage claims (e.g. THC/CBD percentages, 'strongest', 'guaranteed high') presented as a promotional selling point rather than neutral product information?
rules.citation: Drafted from publicly available state cannabis-advertising regulations — not yet legal-reviewed.
rules.suggestedFixTemplate: Present potency/dosage figures as neutral factual labeling only, not as a promotional claim or superlative.

rules.title: THC/potency content not used as the primary marketing hook
rules.checkPrompt: Is a specific THC or potency number displayed as the dominant, largest, or most prominent element of the creative, functioning as the main selling point?
rules.citation: Drafted from publicly available state cannabis-advertising regulations — not yet legal-reviewed.
rules.suggestedFixTemplate: De-emphasize potency figures relative to brand/product name; avoid making THC content the visual focal point.

rules.title: No imagery of a person actively consuming cannabis
rules.checkPrompt: Does the image depict a person actively smoking, vaping, inhaling, or otherwise consuming a cannabis product (as opposed to simply holding or displaying it)?
rules.citation: Drafted from publicly available state cannabis-advertising regulations — not yet legal-reviewed.
rules.suggestedFixTemplate: Replace consumption imagery with product-display-only imagery (packaging, product shot without active use).

rules.title: No imagery suggesting excessive or binge consumption
rules.checkPrompt: Does the image depict large quantities of product being consumed or imply encouragement of excessive/binge use (e.g. many products consumed at once, 'party' overconsumption framing)?
rules.citation: Drafted from publicly available state cannabis-advertising regulations — not yet legal-reviewed.
rules.suggestedFixTemplate: Reduce quantity/framing to a single, moderate serving and remove overconsumption cues.

rules.title: No depiction of use while driving or operating machinery
rules.checkPrompt: Does the image depict a person using cannabis while driving a vehicle or operating machinery/equipment, or otherwise associate product use with a hazardous activity?
rules.citation: Drafted from publicly available state cannabis-advertising regulations — not yet legal-reviewed.
rules.suggestedFixTemplate: Remove any association between product use and driving, operating machinery, or other hazardous activities.

rules.title: No packaging/branding resembling children's products
rules.checkPrompt: Does the product packaging or branding shown resemble candy, snacks, or other children's products/brands in shape, color scheme, or naming?
rules.citation: Drafted from publicly available state cannabis-advertising regulations — not yet legal-reviewed.
rules.suggestedFixTemplate: Redesign packaging/branding to avoid resemblance to candy, snack, or children's product conventions.

rules.title: No imagery encouraging overconsumption via price/promotion framing
rules.checkPrompt: Does the image feature 'free', 'buy one get one', bulk-discount, or giveaway framing that could reasonably encourage purchasing or consuming more product than intended?
rules.citation: Drafted from publicly available state cannabis-advertising regulations — not yet legal-reviewed.
rules.suggestedFixTemplate: Remove or reword promotional framing so it does not incentivize bulk purchase or overconsumption.

rules.title: State license number disclosure present where required
rules.checkPrompt: If this creative is a storefront, dispensary, or licensed-retailer advertisement, is a state cannabis business license number or equivalent regulatory identifier visible in the image?
rules.citation: Drafted from publicly available state cannabis-advertising regulations — not yet legal-reviewed.
rules.suggestedFixTemplate: Add the applicable state license number in a legible location on the creative.
